claim: Evaluation requires an answer key or rubric that states the expected behavior for each case.
Runtime evaluations can check production data when the system has useful invariants.
The speakers recommend checking intermediate pipeline outputs rather than only the final response.
A golden set should be refreshed by spot checking production data and adding new cases on a cadence.
The episode warns that a pipeline can overfit its golden dataset.
The recommended starting point is a handful of cases that force the builder to read the prompt and outputs.
The speakers report production extraction pipelines above 99 percent accuracy, while explaining that failures still require investigation.
note: Speaker report, not independently verified here.
